verdict_reason: The seed itself is sound, but three doc lines added in this PR say it holds five addresses when it holds six.

todos.issue: TYPED_SEED holds six addresses (originAndConsignor, placeOfOrigin, consigneeAndDestination, importer, branch, branchDepot; address-book.roles.test.js:35-40 asserts all six), but the docs this PR adds say the -typed seed holds five: docs/services.md:59 ('-typed for five addresses holding roles of all three address types'), docs/testing.md:246 ('five addresses holding roles of all three address types') and docs/add-a-page.md:136 ('five-typed-record seeds'). A test author sizing a page or a count from the docs gets the wrong number.
todos.fix: Must: every doc line describing the -typed seed states the count TYPED_SEED actually holds, or states no count. One way: change 'five' to 'six' in services.md:59, testing.md:246 and add-a-page.md:136, or drop the number and point at typed-seed.js.
